name: adapt_cart_limit_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_items.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into cart.go
prompts: Create cart.go (package cartcase) with a function CanAdd(count int) bool returning true if count is less than or equal to the integer in max_items.txt (currently 5), else false. Read the limit from the file (os.ReadFile) at call time - do not hardcode it.
max_items.txt has changed. Make sure CanAdd() enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.

disruptions.description: max_items.txt tightened to a lower limit
